notes: The 2026-10-03 four-source M6 study, the tail-safe report, the 2026-08-07 Court checkpoint, and the 2026-10-13 archived ablation are separate evidence scopes.
Editorial GT means human-edited video intervals. It is not physical LIVE/DEAD or verified Hit truth.
All M6 screenshots are frozen offline research visualizations, not production output.
